theorem approved_orders (e : Execution) (hv : Valid topology e) :
    ∀ g v, e.present g "x.order" = some v →
      e.present g "r.approved" = some v ∨ g = Tag.zero := by
  intro g v hp
  rcases present_from hv hp with ⟨_, id, hw, -⟩ | ⟨c, hc, g', hg, hs⟩ | ⟨port, -, -, -, h0⟩
  · simp [topology, Topology.writers, Topology.Reaction.mayWrite] at hw
  · simp [topology, Topology.sources] at hc
    subst hc
    left
    simpa [Tag.after] using hg ▸ hs
  · exact Or.inr h0

properties.name: orders_are_approved
properties.statement:
∀ g v, e.present g "x.order" = some v →
      e.present g "r.approved" = some v ∨ g = Tag.zero
properties.proof:
by
  intro g v hp
  rcases present_from hv hp with ⟨_, id, hw, -⟩ | ⟨c, hc, g', hg, hs⟩ | ⟨port, -, -, -, h0⟩
  · simp [topology, Topology.writers, Topology.Reaction.mayWrite] at hw
  · simp [topology, Topology.sources] at hc
    subst hc
    left
    simpa [Tag.after] using hg ▸ hs
  · exact Or.inr h0

properties.name: rejected_not_executed
properties.statement:
∀ g, g ≠ Tag.zero → (e.wrote g "r.reaction.0" "r.rejected").isSome →
      ¬ e.invoked g "x.reaction.0"
properties.proof:
by
  intro g hg hrej hinv
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hid, t, ht, htrig⟩ := invoked_from hv hinv
  simp [topology] at hr
  rcases hr with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> simp at hid
  simp at ht
  subst ht
  rcases htrig with hp | ⟨tm, htm, -⟩
  · obtain ⟨v, hv'⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp hp
    rcases approved_orders e hv g v hv' with ha | h0
    · rcases present_from hv ha with ⟨g', id, hw, hc, hwr, hl⟩ | ⟨c, hc, -⟩ | ⟨port, hport, hn, hk, -⟩
      · simp [topology, Topology.writers, Topology.Reaction.mayWrite] at hw
        subst hw
        simp [topology, Topology.land, Topology.port?] at hl
        subst hl
        have hh := completed_honours hv (r := topology.reactions[1]) (by simp [topology]) hc
        simp [honours, topology] at hh
        have := hh.2
        simp [hwr, hrej] at this
      · simp [topology, Topology.sources] at hc
      · simp [topology] at hport
        rcases hport with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> simp_all
    · exact hg h0
  · simp [topology] at htm
